One candidate per class: whatever models.json currently binds. This answers
'what does a turn cost and how long does the student wait', which is a
different question from 'which model should serve this class' and needs its
own run — a comparison run buries the incumbent among rivals.
Re-run this after every re-binding. It is cheap: one call per case.
